newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY GRANTS HUF 12 BLN GUARANTEE TO POSTABANK.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY GRANTS HUF 12 BLN GUARANTEE TO POSTABANK.

text.p: Hungary's government has decided to grant on Thursday a 12 billion forints guarantee on some investments of Postabank Rt, the country's second largest commercial bank hit by panic withdrawals of some 23 billion forints in February, a government official said.
"The state involvement represents a serious guarantee (for the bank) in this transitionary period," government spokesman Elemer Kiss told a news conference following the government meeting. MORE
Kiss added that most of Postabank's owners had already signed an agreement with the government that they would return within five years any funds taken up by Postabank under the guarantee scheme.
"Postsparkasse was the only owner who did not agree to that," Kiss said.
Hungary's social security funds hold some 35 percent of Postabank, Oesterreischische Postsparkasse holds 10.4 percent while the stake of Bank Austria is about three percent.

Kiss said there is a chance that the bank's efforts to find foreign investors for a capital increase would be successful before the end of the year and that the new shares could be issued at a price above face value.
Earlier the bank appointed SBC Warburg to search for foreign investors which would acquire a stake in the bank.
Kiss could not give further details of the agreement.

A Postabank official said they were consulting with the Finance Ministry which is acting on the government's behalf in the extension of the guarantee and added that details of the deal will emerge later.
